# Longest Palindrome.

@example Two c's and two b's mirror each other around the a, as in "bcacb"; one c and one b are left over.
"cabbcbc"
=> 5

@example No two tiles match (G and g are different), so the longest row is a single tile.
"GgHh"
=> 1

@example Each letter occurs an even number of times, so all six tiles fit, as in "zwzzwz".
"wzzwzz"
=> 6

# A single letter.
"k"
=> 1

# One letter repeated, an even and an odd number of times: every tile fits.
"qqqq"
=> 4

"qqqqq"
=> 5

# Upper and lower case never pair up: counting them together would give 6.
"AaBbCc"
=> 1

# The same letter in both cases: three m's and two M's all fit, but of
# three M's and three m's, one of each is left over.
"mMmMm"
=> 5

"MmMmMm"
=> 5

# Three letters three times each: each gives a pair, but only one of the
# three leftovers fits in the middle.
"xyzxyzxyz"
=> 7

# Five p's give two pairs and a middle tile; r and t are left over.
"rpppppt"
=> 5

# The letters u to z, which lie 6 places past Z in ASCII, then a Z.
"zyxwvuuvwxyzZ"
=> 13

# All 52 letters once each.
"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
=> 1

# All 52 letters twice each.
"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzzyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcbaZYXWVUTSRQPONMLKJIHGFEDCBA"
=> 104

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
"AuuAZZZ"
=> 7

@gen 2 small
"c"
=> 1

@gen 3 small
"x"
=> 1

@gen 4 small
"qQq"
=> 3

@gen 5 small
"Zy"
=> 1

@gen 6 small
"abababbaba"
=> 9

@gen 7 small
"YZyyy"
=> 3

# Full size: 2000 letters, every letter an odd number of times; every
# letter an even number of times; random letters.
@gen 1
""
=> 1949

@gen 2
""
=> 2000

@gen 5
""
=> 1971

# Full size, one letter 1999 times: every tile fits, and a count kept in
# a char would wrap around.
@gen 8
""
=> 1999

# Full size, one letter in both cases, 1001 times as B and 999 times as b:
# one tile of each is left over.
@gen 4
""
=> 1999
